title: Humaeli Terms & Conditions
introduction: These Terms & Conditions describe the use of the Humaeli mobile application by individual users and consultants. Read them together with the separate Privacy Policy before creating an account.

sections.title: 1. About Humaeli and these Terms
paragraphs: Humaeli Mental Wellness (“Humaeli”) is operated by MindCrawller Global Private Limited (“we”, “us” or “our”). Our website is https://humaeli.com. You can contact us at support@humaeli.com.

These Terms cover the Humaeli mobile application and the services made available within the applicable version. They do not automatically cover separate website, employer, clinic or other platform arrangements. A separate written agreement with a consultant or organization may impose additional obligations; it cannot remove rights that applicable law protects.

Before creating an account, you should be able to open and read these Terms and the separate Privacy Policy. Registration requires an affirmative acceptance action. Opening a document, viewing a link, or receiving a device permission prompt is not acceptance of these Terms. Privacy choices that require separate consent remain separate from agreement to these Terms.

sections.title: 2. Eligibility and account information
paragraphs: You must be at least 18 years old and legally able to enter into an agreement to create an account under these Terms. These Terms do not establish a service for minors or a parent/guardian consent process.

Provide accurate registration and contact information and keep it reasonably up to date. Where the app permits an anonymous display name, that name does not make the account anonymous to Humaeli or remove the need for accurate account or professional information. Do not impersonate another person or misrepresent your age, role, identity or qualifications.

Keep your password and account access secure. Do not share passwords or one-time passwords. Contact support if you believe an unauthorized person has accessed your account. You are responsible for your own use of the service; this does not make you responsible for a security incident caused by us or remove protections provided by law.

sections.title: 3. Services and feature availability
paragraphs: Humaeli provides access to the features shown in the applicable app version, which may include consultant discovery, appointments, text conversations, profile information, selected file sharing and an in-app notification inbox.

Features vary by platform, release and service availability. The current iOS release supports text-based interactions and does not offer audio/video calls, QR scanning, GPS updates, push delivery or biometric App Lock. It can let you select individual photos or documents using system selection tools. Features available on Android may differ from the iOS release; the features shown in your installed version determine what is available.

Do not assume that a feature advertised for the website or another Humaeli service is available in your mobile release. AI functionality on other clients is outside the current iOS release and requires its own applicable disclosures and permissions. These Terms do not authorize undisclosed AI processing of your conversations.

We do not guarantee continuous availability, an immediate consultant response, a particular appointment slot, or a specific wellness outcome. We will take reasonable care in providing the service. Material service changes should be communicated where appropriate, and any rights you have under applicable law remain unaffected.

sections.title: 4. Wellness information and professional services
paragraphs: General wellness information and platform content are for information and support. They do not, by themselves, establish a diagnosis, prescribe treatment, or replace an assessment by an appropriately qualified professional. Do not delay seeking appropriate care because of app content or a message that has not yet received a professional response.

A consultant must identify their professional role accurately and act within their qualifications, permissions and applicable professional requirements. Availability of a profile is not a guarantee of suitability, a particular credential, or a treatment outcome. Ask the consultant about their role, qualifications and the scope of the proposed service when needed.

Whether a particular interaction constitutes regulated medical care depends on the professional, the actual service and applicable law. These Terms do not authorize a person to provide services they are not qualified or legally permitted to provide, and do not replace professional informed-consent or record-keeping requirements.
Nothing in these Terms excludes a duty of care or responsibility that cannot lawfully be excluded.

sections.title: 5. Emergencies and urgent risk
paragraphs: Humaeli is not an emergency response service. Messages, support emails and reports may not be monitored immediately. If you or someone else is in immediate danger, contact local emergency services or seek urgent assistance from an appropriate local professional. Do not rely on an app conversation or support email for an emergency response.

sections.title: 6. Appointments, fees and cancellations
paragraphs: In the current mobile service, appointment booking is free and ordinary user chat is free. The current iOS release has no wallet, earnings screen, payment gateway, withdrawal facility or payment step. Booking does not create a charge or an entitlement to earnings.

Any test or demonstration balances or transactions shown outside these public mobile workflows have no monetary value and cannot be withdrawn or redeemed. Historical records do not establish that a payment service is currently available.

Confirm the appointment details shown in the app and use available controls to cancel, reject or update an appointment when your plans change. An appointment request is not confirmation of acceptance until the app indicates the applicable status. Contact support if a status appears incorrect.

These Terms do not introduce a cancellation fee or subscription. Any future paid service must present its price, applicable payment terms and required acceptance before a charge is incurred, and must comply with the relevant app-store rules and applicable law. We do not obtain authorization to charge you merely through acceptance of these Terms.

sections.title: 7. Consultant responsibilities
paragraphs: Consultants must provide accurate professional information and keep qualifications and permissions current. Do not claim to hold a licence, registration, specialization or affiliation that you do not hold. Provide services only within your competence and applicable professional scope.

Protect information received through the service. Access and use another person's information only as necessary for the authorized interaction and lawful professional obligations. Do not disclose private messages, attachments or identifiable health information to unauthorized persons. Professional confidentiality may be subject to lawful exceptions; these Terms do not promise absolute confidentiality in every circumstance.

Do not use the platform for exploitation, discrimination, improper solicitation, unauthorized recording or services prohibited by law. Follow applicable professional requirements concerning consent, safeguarding, documentation and urgent risk. These Terms do not establish employment status, remuneration, revenue sharing or a separate professional-services contract.

sections.title: 8. Acceptable use and conversation safety
paragraphs: Treat other people respectfully. Do not use Humaeli to:

- Harass, threaten, stalk, discriminate against or exploit another person.
- Share child sexual abuse material, non-consensual intimate content, unlawful sexual content or other unlawful material.
- Publish another person's private information without authority, or upload content you do not have the right to share.
- Impersonate a professional, falsify qualifications, manipulate reviews, send spam or make fraudulent claims.
- Distribute malware, attempt unauthorized access, bypass account or safety controls, or interfere with the service.

Use the in-app report and block controls for inappropriate interactions and contact support for concerns. Blocking limits supported future interactions; it does not recall copies already received or erase all existing records. Safety reporting is separate from emergency assistance and account deletion.

We may review reported content and take proportionate action, including restricting content or access, where reasonably necessary for safety, security, these Terms or legal obligations. Where appropriate and legally permitted, we will explain a restriction and provide a way to contact support about a mistake. We do not promise that every item of content is reviewed before it appears.

sections.title: 9. Your content and limited permission to operate the service
paragraphs: You retain any rights you hold in messages, photos, documents and other content you submit. Share only content you are entitled to provide, and consider whether a file contains information about another person.

You give us a limited, non-exclusive permission to store, transmit, display to intended recipients and otherwise process that content only as needed to provide the requested service, operate its safety and support functions, and meet applicable legal obligations. This is not a sale of your content or a licence to use private health information in advertising.

A recipient may already have seen or retained information you shared. Available message deletion, blocking and account deletion controls have different effects. Our use and retention of personal data are described in the separate Privacy Policy. This content permission does not replace any consent or other lawful basis required for processing personal data.

sections.title: 10. Privacy and security
paragraphs: Read the Humaeli mobile Privacy Policy separately from these Terms. The currently published iOS-specific policy is available at https://chatbot-backend-production-82fb.up.railway.app/privacy/ios. The Privacy Policy explains the personal information, health-related information, conversations and selected files processed to provide the service and the relevant provider and retention practices.

The absence of camera, microphone, location or notification permission prompts does not mean that the app collects no personal data. App-store privacy disclosures must remain accurate for the actual release and its SDKs.

Use of HTTPS and secure account-token storage does not mean that stored conversations are end-to-end encrypted. No internet service can promise absolute security. Report suspected security or privacy issues to support@humaeli.com. Withdrawing a device permission or uninstalling the app does not itself delete your account or existing server records.

sections.title: 11. Account closure, retention and deletion
paragraphs: You can request account deletion through Settings > Delete Account. If you cannot access your account, contact support@humaeli.com. We may need to verify ownership to protect you from an unauthorized request. Never send your password or a one-time password to support.

Recording a deletion request disables account access and revokes supported active sessions. It is not confirmation that all data has already been erased. Under the current operational policy, account, clinical, financial and related records are retained for 90 days from the deletion request before account-data erasure is scheduled.

Applicable legal retention obligations and active legal holds may require a different treatment for particular records. Provider and backup cleanup must be verified before deletion is confirmed. Do not treat the end of 90 days as confirmation that an unresolved hold or provider task is complete. We will explain applicable delays and retained record categories to the requester and provide confirmation after the deletion process is completed. Contact support for progress or clarification.

This clause does not create a legal justification to retain data that should be deleted sooner or permit destruction of records that the law requires to be retained longer. Applicable legal retention requirements take priority over a general operational period.

paragraphs: Humaeli's branding, application software and other materials supplied by us remain owned by us or the relevant rights holder. Subject to these Terms, you may use the app for its intended purposes. This does not give you ownership of Humaeli's name, software or other proprietary materials. Rights provided by applicable law are not restricted.

The app may use third-party authentication, storage, delivery or other services. Where separate third-party terms apply to a service you choose, those terms should be made available as appropriate. Third-party availability is outside our complete control, but using a provider does not remove our responsibilities under applicable law. Do not share another service's credentials with Humaeli support.

sections.title: 13. Suspension, ending use and changes to these Terms
paragraphs: You may stop using Humaeli at any time. Stopping use does not itself erase your account; use the deletion process if you want to request account-data removal.

We may suspend or end access where reasonably necessary to address a serious breach, fraud, security risk, risk of harm or legal obligation. Restrictions should be proportionate, and support should be available to review an apparent error where appropriate. Suspending an account is not a substitute for processing a valid deletion request.

If these Terms materially change, we will identify the updated version and effective date and communicate the change as appropriate. Where fresh acceptance or separate consent is required, we will obtain it rather than treating the mere opening of the app as consent to every change. This does not exclude liability for fraud, deliberate misconduct, unlawful data handling, professional negligence or any other responsibility that cannot lawfully be excluded.

These Terms do not impose an arbitrary liability cap, a broad user indemnity, mandatory arbitration or a waiver of consumer rights. Any later additional limitation must be lawful, fair and disclosed in an updated version of these Terms.

sections.title: 15. Complaints, applicable law and contact
paragraphs: Contact support@humaeli.com for service, account, privacy or Terms questions. Describe the issue and provide only the information needed to identify your request. Do not include passwords or one-time passwords.
